programs.description: Three college friends decide to open a resort. However, their lives change when they start experiencing paranormal activities in their resort.
The filmmaker explores Santosh's transformative journey across Karnataka, capturing life-changing experiences and deep spiritual insights.
Ravi works for Veljibhai Soda, a gangster, and does illegal work for him. Once, he is asked to vacate Ali from his property, but he gets inspired by his ideals and decides to change his ways.
Lord Shiva and Goddess Parvati fall in love at the start of the universe. Their eternal love story becomes a legendary tale of devotion for future generations.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
A blooming romance between an outgoing young man and an introverted woman falls apart as they shy away from professing their feelings. However, fate unites them in mysterious ways.
A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.
When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.
